question: Measured against the budget promised when they won the bid, by how much have Olympic Games overrun on average?
answer: About 170%, in real terms. Flyvbjerg, Budzier and Lunn found that every Games since 1960 with usable data overran, by 172% on average, the worst record of any kind of megaproject they studied. A fixed opening date and no way to shrink the event leave cost as the only thing that can give.
move: A deadline that cannot move turns every problem into a cost.
ask: What deadline of mine cannot move, so that every surprise just turns into extra cost?
trap: Starting from the bid budget, a fifth over already sounds like a scandal.
reference: Flyvbjerg, Budzier & Lunn, Regression to the Tail: Why the Olympics Blow Up, Environment and Planning A: Economy and Space, 2021
